[[Runavík]], [[Faroes]] | capacity = 2,000 | chairman = Karstin Joensen | manager = [[Sigurður Ragnar Eyjólfsson]] | league = [[Faroe Islands Premier League]] | season = [[2025 Faroe Islands Premier League|2025]] | position = Faroe Islands Premier League, 3rd of 10 | website = http://www.nsi.fo/ | pattern_la1 = | pattern_b1 = _nsi21h | pattern_ra1 = | pattern_sh1 = _adidascondivo20bw | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = FFDD00 | body1 = FFDD00 | rightarm1 = FFDD00 | shorts1 = 000000 | socks1 = FFDD00 | pattern_la2 = _kups18a | pattern_b2 = _kups18a | pattern_ra2 = _kups18a | leftarm2 = 000000 | body2 = 000000 | rightarm2 = 000000 | shorts2 = 000000 | socks2 = 000000 }} '''NSÍ Runavík''' is a [[Faroe Islands|Faroese]] professional [[association football|football]] club, playing in [[Runavík]] on the island of [[Eysturoy]]. It was founded 24 March 1957. In 2003 NSÍ participated for the first time on a European stage. In 2007, the club won the [[Faroe Islands Premier League]] for the first time. The club has won the [[Faroe Islands Cup]] in 1986, 2002 and 2017. Aside from these instances, NSÍ Runavík featured in the 1980, 1985, 1988, 2004 and 2015 tournament finals. The club plays in yellow and black. Their stadium ([[Runavík Stadium|Við Løkin]]) has a capacity of 2,000. It is not approved by [[UEFA]] for international play, so Runavík play their [[UEFA Europa League]] matches at [[Tórsvøllur]] in [[Tórshavn]] or [[Svangaskarð]] in [[Toftir]]. The main sponsor of NSÍ is [[Navigare.fo|Navigare]], which is based in [[Runavík]] near [[Bakkafrost]] which is the largest salmon-farming company in the Faroe Islands. It is one of the biggest private employers in the islands, if not the biggest.{{cite web|url=http://www.fishupdate.com/bakkafrost-chief-financial-officer-quits/|title=Bakkafrost Chief Financial Officer quits|date=7 October 2014|publisher=Fishupdate.com|access-date=23 September 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150925083335/http://www.fishupdate.com/bakkafrost-chief-financial-officer-quits/|archive-date=25 September 2015|url-status=dead}}"}}
